name: zgeometry_weiler_classify_contained_contour
description: zGeometry_Weiler::ClassifyContainedContour walks the preclassified contour packet, detects/handles intersections through accepted helper contracts, and returns the aggregate intersect result.
known_limits: Binary Ninja HLIL still renders several ClassifyAdjacentEdgePairAgainstContourSegment callsites as EAX/x87 tuples despite callsite x87 adjustments fixed to 0; assembly and direct callee contracts are used as evidence.

The smoke target covers the non-overlap aggregate path directly; intersection and split subcontracts are covered by the accepted functional targets for Intersect2d, DivideContourSegmentAtPoint, ClassifyAdjacentEdgePairAgainstContourSegment, and ClassifyAdjacentEdgePairAgainstAdjacentEdgePair.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry Weiler source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x465ac0 validates contour packet field loading, paired contour segment iteration, dirty-bounds update checks, SegmentBoundsOverlapXY gating, existing-xing checks, Intersect2d dispatch, aggregate result OR, xing clearing, divide-at-xing handling, post-xing segment advancement, xing back-reference propagation when xingBuffer.count is nonzero, and error exits.
The native clip leaf smoke verifies a four-contour packet with disjoint segment bounds returns aggregate result 0 without creating xings.
